articles.title: 酚醛树脂配件入门：材料特性、优势与应用场景
articles.titleEn: Getting Started with Phenolic Resin Parts: Properties, Advantages & Applications
articles.excerpt: 酚醛树脂是最早实现工业化的合成高分子材料，拥有优异的耐热、绝缘、耐磨特性，是机械配件领域的经典之选。
articles.excerptEn: Phenolic resin was the first industrialized synthetic polymer material, with excellent heat resistance, insulation, and wear resistance properties. It is a classic choice in mechanical parts.

articles.title: 如何为你的应用选择合适的酚醛树脂型号
articles.titleEn: How to Choose the Right Phenolic Resin Grade for Your Application
articles.excerpt: PF1、PF2、PF3…酚醛树脂型号繁多，不同型号在耐热、强度、电性能上有显著差异，选错型号直接影响产品可靠性。
articles.excerptEn: PF1, PF2, PF3... There are many phenolic resin grades with significant differences in heat resistance, strength, and electrical properties. Choosing the wrong grade directly affects product reliability.

articles.title: 酚醛树脂注塑模具设计要点：浇口、流道与冷却系统
articles.titleEn: Key Points in Phenolic Resin Injection Mold Design: Gates, Runners & Cooling
articles.excerpt: 酚醛树脂流动性差、热稳定性高，对模具设计有特殊要求。浇口位置、流道直径、冷却水道布局都是决定产品良率的关键。
articles.excerptEn: Phenolic resin has poor flowability and high thermal stability, requiring special mold design considerations. Gate location, runner diameter, and cooling channel layout are key to product yield.

articles.title: 酚醛树脂配件质检方法：尺寸、外观、功能三维度检验
articles.titleEn: Quality Control Methods for Phenolic Resin Parts: Inspection from Three Dimensions
articles.excerpt: 外观缺陷、尺寸超差、功能失效——酚醛树脂配件质检三维度详解，建立有效的出厂检验体系。
articles.excerptEn: Appearance defects, dimensional deviations, functional failures - detailed explanation of three-dimensional quality inspection for phenolic resin parts. Establish an effective factory inspection system.

articles.title: 酚醛树脂配件行业应用案例：从石油钻井到轨道交通
articles.titleEn: Industry Application Cases of Phenolic Resin Parts: From Oil Drilling to Rail Transit
articles.excerpt: 酚醛树脂配件广泛应用于石油、化工、轨道交通、医疗器械等领域。来看几个有代表性的真实应用场景。
articles.excerptEn: Phenolic resin parts are widely used in oil drilling, chemical, rail transit, medical devices and other fields. Let's look at some representative real application scenarios.

articles.title: 非标定制酚醛树脂配件：如何与工厂高效沟通需求
articles.titleEn: Custom Phenolic Resin Parts: How to Communicate Your Requirements with the Factory
articles.excerpt: 非标定制最大的成本是沟通。图纸不规范、规格不清晰是延误和返工的主要原因。本文分享如何一次说清楚需求。
articles.excerptEn: The biggest cost of custom manufacturing is communication. Incomplete drawings and unclear specifications are the main causes of delays and rework. This article shares how to communicate requirements clearly in one go.

articles.title: 酚醛胶木手轮 vs 铸铁：为何在工业设备配套中更胜一筹
articles.titleEn: Bakelite Handwheel vs. Cast Iron: Why Bakelite Wins in Industrial Equipment Matching
articles.excerpt: 酚醛胶木手轮相比铸铁手轮减重55-65%，耐温≥150°C，电气绝缘，耐腐蚀。本文通过4个实际案例对比分析，帮助采购工程师做出正确的材料选择。
articles.excerptEn: Bakelite handwheels are 55-65% lighter than cast iron, with heat resistance ≥150°C, electrical insulation, and corrosion resistance. This article provides detailed comparison analysis with 4 real-world case studies to help procurement engineers make informed material selections.
